Patch 0.27.0 (Remote basic attacks now replicate as immediate action starts)

  • Attack start is explicit: Remote basic attacks now broadcast an explicit attack-start event instead of waiting for later damage or state side effects.
  • Remote swings read sooner: Other clients now rotate nearby remote players into their swing target and kick the attack animation immediately when the server accepts the hit attempt.
  • Smaller intent-to-impact gap: This narrows the gap between remote melee intent and visible impact before the later broader action-replication pass.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for explicit remote basic-attack replication and 0.27.0 version presentation.

Patch 0.26.0 (Large overworld corrections stop hard-snapping the local view)

  • Authority stays server-side: Large self movement corrections still apply the server position immediately for gameplay truth.
  • View snaps less: After a big overworld correction, the local player mesh and locked camera now ease into the corrected position over a short visual window instead of popping there in one frame.
  • Jump path keeps priority: Authoritative jump visuals still override the new correction smoothing so airborne travel does not get a second conflicting interpolation pass.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for self-correction visual smoothing, correction expiry, jump-priority handling, and 0.26.0 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.4 (The daily return loop now has a real closeout guide and QA route)

  • Help screen closeout: Help now includes a Daily Return Loop reference that ties together the Journal ladder, ET reset clock, nearby party reward bonus, and Trading House circulation path.
  • Retention loop stays grounded: The guide only points at systems that already exist in the game, so the 0.25 closeout explains the real sticky loop instead of promising fake weekly sludge.
  • Release QA route recorded: Added a dedicated 0.25 retention QA checklist covering Journal reset timing, party bonus visibility, dungeon rerun ladder, and Trading House flow.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for the Daily Return Loop help reference and 0.25.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.3 (Daily reset messaging now runs off the real server clock)

  • Authoritative reset timing: Quest Journal reset messaging now runs off authoritative server time instead of a static daily-reset sentence.
  • Live ladder countdown: Repeatable ladder copy now shows exactly how long remains before the next reset, giving live-ops and tuning work a truthful clock to point at.
  • Clock stays honest: The HUD clock now reads from the same server-time feed, so daily reset messaging and the visible clock stop drifting apart.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative reset countdown rendering, journal refresh on server-time ticks, and 0.25.3 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.2 (The Quest Journal now shows the repeatable ladder worth coming back for)

  • Daily ladder is visible: Quest Journal now surfaces a repeatable ladder summary for the highest-value daily quests instead of hiding the best return loop behind accepted-only entries.
  • Status reads clearly: The journal now shows which top dailies are Active, Ready, or still Available, along with a quick accepted-versus-ready count.
  • 0.25 retention loop pass: This gives max-level players a visible come-back-tomorrow XP ladder without adding fake mobile-style sludge systems.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for repeatable ladder journal rendering, high-value daily visibility, and 0.25.2 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.1 (Trading House rows now explain what happens next)

  • Browse rows read better: Trading House browse rows now surface bid state and time remaining so search results stop reading like bare item ledgers.
  • Listing intent is clearer: Listing flow now explains starting bid, buyout, and the sold-auction payout path before you post.
  • Collection outcome is explicit: My Auctions now makes it clearer whether you are collecting gold or reclaiming an unsold item.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for trading-house tab guidance, auction timing hints, collection outcome messaging, and 0.25.1 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.0 (Party play now does a better job of selling why it matters)

  • Party value is visible: The party panel now explains why grouping matters by calling out shared nearby kill rewards, dungeon boss credit, and the live party reward bonus.
  • Roster roles read clearly: Party members now show clearer role tags like Leader, You, and Member instead of reading like anonymous HP bars.
  • Invites sell the upside: Party invite prompts now explain the cooperative upside before you accept.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for party benefit guidance, role visibility in the party panel, invite benefit messaging, and 0.25.0 version presentation.

Patch 0.24.4 (Party dungeon state now reads clearly before you click in)

  • Party run state is explicit: The Dungeon Guide now spells out whether the party is starting a fresh run, continuing a live run, or sitting on an empty instance that is about to collapse.
  • Leader ownership is visible: Leader-only reset ownership is now explicit in the menu, while non-leaders are told they can only continue the current party instance.
  • Buttons read like group actions: Enter and reset buttons now read like party actions instead of generic solo-instance verbs.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for party instance state messaging, continue-versus-start labeling, leader-only reset controls, and 0.24.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.24.3 (The Dungeon Guide now shows why another run is worth doing)

  • Visible rerun ladder: The Dungeon Guide now surfaces a live repeat-run ladder tied to your accepted daily dungeon boss quests instead of leaving that incentive buried in the quest list.
  • Selected route matters: The ladder updates by selected dungeon and difficulty so players can see which reruns are still paying the strongest daily XP before they commit to the next run.
  • 0.24 reward-ladder pass: This gives max-level dungeon play a visible reward ladder before the later party-flow hardening pass.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for dungeon menu repeat-run ladder rendering, selected dungeon/difficulty daily quest visibility, and 0.24.3 version presentation.

Patch 0.24.2 (Heroic and Mythic now read like distinct endgame reward lanes)

  • Endgame reward identity: Heroic bosses now guarantee a bonus gem drop, while Mythic bosses guarantee both a bonus gem and a unique-effect item on top of the normal boss payout.
  • Difficulty reads better up front: The dungeon menu now explains each difficulty as a distinct endgame lane instead of only listing stat multipliers, so Heroic reads like a gem chase and Mythic reads like a capstone build-defining push.
  • Reward summary tells the truth: Boss reward summaries now surface the exact Heroic or Mythic bonus rule that paid out on the kill, matching the authoritative server reward logic.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for endgame difficulty reward notes, guaranteed Mythic unique-effect gear, dungeon menu identity copy, and 0.24.2 version presentation.
